mapper.select: SELECT cert_id as certId, student_id as studentId, cert_name as certName, score_or_grade as scoreOrGrade, obtain_time as obtainTime, supplementary_desc as supplementaryDesc, create_time as createTime FROM certificate_qualification WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM certificate_qualification WHERE cert_id = #{certId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
